scholarship_title: Banach NAWA Programme (Prof. Stefan Banach Scholarship Programme) 2026
provider_organization: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA), with the Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: 100% fee exemption at public universities; private universities set their own terms

stipend.notes: Paid for a maximum of 12 months per academic year (max 5 in winter semester, 7 in summer semester)

additional_benefits: Airfare (one-off lump sum for international travel, paid with the first stipend)
Polish language and culture course (English-taught path)

application_fee.notes: No fee to NAWA. The Polish university may charge its own admission fee; proof of paying it is one accepted way to show you are in its admission process.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Bachelor's average must earn at least 50 of 70 points on NAWA's formula (about 71% of the maximum on your grading scale); total score at least 70 of 110
language_proficiency: English B2 (certificate from NAWA's Appendix 4 list)
Polish B1 for the preparatory course

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is in country group 4 with Azerbaijan only. The group closes early once 200 applications are submitted, so apply early in the window. Places per country are set by the assessment team.

required_documents: Bachelor's diploma with supplement showing grade average and all subject grades (or a university certificate if graduating by 15 Jul 2026)
Proof of admission or of contact with a Polish university for a specific programme
Self-presentation video (1-3 minutes, Polish or English)
Optional: recommendation letter from a Polish diplomatic mission (worth up to 10 points)
preparation_alerts: Bachelor's must be obtained in a programme country in 2024 or later
Documents not in Polish or English need a sworn translation
Start Polish university admission before the NAWA deadline

source_urls.used_for: All eligibility, funding, document, scoring and date fields

verification_status.verification_notes: Verified against NAWA call No. 16/2026. Next call not yet announced (2025 call opened in June, 2026 call in April). The 2022 tweet described this as STEM-only; the 2026 call has no field restriction.
